prompt: Which sequence of SI prefixes is arranged in order of strictly decreasing numerical multiplier?

answer.explanation: Mega is 10^6, kilo is 10^3, milli is 10^-3, and micro is 10^-6, which forms a strictly decreasing sequence.

distractor_explanations: Incorrect. This sequence is strictly increasing (10^-6 to 10^6).
Incorrect. Nano (10^-9) is smaller than micro (10^-6), so placing nano before micro violates monotonic decrease.
Incorrect. Milli (10^-3) is smaller than centi (10^-2), so placing milli before centi is out of order.
hints: Write out the power of 10 for each prefix in the list.
Check that each power is strictly smaller than the previous one.
solution: The multipliers are: Mega = 10^6, kilo = 10^3, milli = 10^-3, micro = 10^-6. Comparing these powers: 6 > 3 > -3 > -6. This is strictly decreasing. In option C, nano (10^-9) precedes micro (10^-6). In option D, milli (10^-3) precedes centi (10^-2). Option A is correct.
teacher_walkthrough: Have students write out the exponent array for each option.
Review prefix definitions from pico (10^-12) to tera (10^12).

provenance.independence_statement: Authored as an original item ordering decimal submultiples and multiples.
